title: Malmgren tracked by Majestic guardians

tellings.quote: They not only CIA but you know all the majestic all these guardians they also themselves to protect the world.

plain: Harold Malmgren, speaking to podcast host Jesse Michels, says he was watched not only by the CIA, the US spy agency, but also by people tied to "Majestic", a name some give to a secret group said to handle UFO matters. He calls them guardians who see themselves as protecting the world. If true, it would mean such a hidden group exists and keeps track of people.
